cards.question:
Does a target-sum subarray exist? (hash set)

Given an integer array `arr` and target sum `K`, determine whether any nonempty subarray sums to `K` using a hash set of previously seen prefix sums.

(No need to count subarrays, simply confirm existence on first occurence.)

Count target-sum subarrays using prefix frequencies (hash map)

Given an integer array `arr` and sum `K`, count all nonempty subarrays whose sum equals `K` using a hash map of prefix-sum frequencies.

Count subarrays whose sum is divisible by `K` (hash map)

Given an integer array `arr` and target sum `K`, count all nonempty subarrays whose sum is divisible by `K`, using a hash map of prefix-remainder frequencies. Handle negative array values.

Longest subarray that sums to `K` (hash map)

Given an integer array `arr` and target sum `K`, identify the longest subarray that sums to `K` using a hash map of prefix-sum indices.
